newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Gunmen kill Pakistani provincial deputy.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen kill Pakistani provincial deputy.

text.p: Masked gunmen killed a Pakistani provincial parliamentary deputy and injured five other people on Saturday in Lahore, police said.

They said Shaukat Butt, an independent deputy of the Punjab provincial assembly, and his four companions, who were injured seriously, were shot by three masked men with automatic weapons when driving in a car in an eastern suburb of Lahore. A passer-by was also injured.
There was no immediate information about the identity of the gunmen or the motive of the attack, the latest in a series of violent incidents in the province in recent months.
Police have blamed militant groups of rival Moslem sects for most previous attacks in Punjab, the home province of Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif.
